paragraphs.en: The Office Harness for AI Agents — Spreadsheets, Docs, Slides, Canvas, Relational Tables, and PDF in one runtime.
paragraphs.zh: AI 智能体的办公套件——将电子表格、文档、幻灯片、画布、关系表和 PDF 集于同一运行时。

paragraphs.en: Spreadsheets · Documents · Presentations · Bases · Boards · PDFs
paragraphs.zh: 电子表格 · 文档 · 演示文稿 · 数据库 · 看板 · PDF

paragraphs.en: High-performance, fully customizable Office SDK
paragraphs.zh: 高性能、完全可自定义的 Office SDK

paragraphs.en: Build embeddable productivity experiences with a plugin architecture, Canvas-based rendering, a formula engine, and one Facade API that works in the browser and on Node.js.
paragraphs.zh: 借助插件架构、基于 Canvas 的渲染、公式引擎以及一个可在浏览器和 Node.js 中运行的 Facade API，构建可嵌入的效率体验。

paragraphs.en: Univer is an open-source SDK for creating office applications inside your own product. It gives you the building blocks for spreadsheet, document, and presentation experiences without forcing you into a hosted app or a fixed UI.
paragraphs.zh: Univer 是一个开源 SDK，用于在你的自有产品中创建办公应用。 它为你提供构建电子表格、文档和演示文稿体验的基础组件，而不会强迫你使用托管应用或固定界面。

sents.en: Univer is an open-source SDK for creating office applications inside your own product.
sents.zh: Univer 是一个开源 SDK，用于在你的自有产品中创建办公应用。

sents.en: It gives you the building blocks for spreadsheet, document, and presentation experiences without forcing you into a hosted app or a fixed UI.
sents.zh: 它为你提供构建电子表格、文档和演示文稿体验的基础组件，而不会强迫你使用托管应用或固定界面。

paragraphs.en: Univer is not a spreadsheet file viewer only. It is a framework for building your own productivity surface.
paragraphs.zh: Univer 不仅仅是电子表格文件查看器。 它是一个用于构建你自己的生产力界面的框架。

sents.en: Univer is not a spreadsheet file viewer only.
sents.zh: Univer 不仅仅是电子表格文件查看器。

sents.en: It is a framework for building your own productivity surface.
sents.zh: 它是一个用于构建你自己的生产力界面的框架。

paragraphs.en: Across the Univer product family , Office tools share a runtime for storage and computation. Content can be composed and embedded across tools, with linked data and references updating together. People and AI agents can work in the same files. See the capability matrix for product coverage and Open Source and Pro for this repository's scope.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Univer 产品家族中，各 Office 工具共享一个用于存储和计算的运行时。 内容可以在各工具之间进行组合与嵌入，链接的数据和引用会一起更新。 人与 AI 智能体可以在同一文件中协作。 请查看能力矩阵以了解产品覆盖范围，并查看 Open Source 与 Pro 以了解本仓库的范围。

sents.en: Across the Univer product family , Office tools share a runtime for storage and computation.
sents.zh: 在 Univer 产品家族中，各 Office 工具共享一个用于存储和计算的运行时。

sents.en: Content can be composed and embedded across tools, with linked data and references updating together.
sents.zh: 内容可以在各工具之间进行组合与嵌入，链接的数据和引用会一起更新。

sents.en: People and AI agents can work in the same files.
sents.zh: 人与 AI 智能体可以在同一文件中协作。

sents.en: See the capability matrix for product coverage and Open Source and Pro for this repository's scope.
sents.zh: 请查看能力矩阵以了解产品覆盖范围，并查看 Open Source 与 Pro 以了解本仓库的范围。

paragraphs.en: Univer Workspace is an open-source, self-hostable workspace built on Univer Office SDK, where people and AI agents create, collaborate on, and review Office content. Developers can use the complete implementation as a reference, learn how to integrate the SDK, and build their own products.
paragraphs.zh: Univer Workspace 是一个基于 Univer Office SDK 构建的开源、可自托管的协作空间，人们和 AI 智能体可以在其中创建、协作和审阅 Office 内容。 开发者可以使用这份完整实现作为参考，学习如何集成该 SDK，并构建自己的产品。

sents.en: Univer Workspace is an open-source, self-hostable workspace built on Univer Office SDK, where people and AI agents create, collaborate on, and review Office content.
sents.zh: Univer Workspace 是一个基于 Univer Office SDK 构建的开源、可自托管的协作空间，人们和 AI 智能体可以在其中创建、协作和审阅 Office 内容。

sents.en: Developers can use the complete implementation as a reference, learn how to integrate the SDK, and build their own products.

paragraphs.en: Univer's AI and collaboration capabilities connect agent operations with interactive editing and human review:
paragraphs.zh: Univer 的 AI 与协作能力将智能体操作与交互式编辑和人工审核连接起来：

paragraphs.en: Use Plugin Mode for complete product coverage and precise composition. For supported Sheets, Docs, and Node profiles, Preset Mode provides a shorter curated setup.
paragraphs.zh: 使用插件模式可获得完整的产品覆盖和精确的组件组合。 对于受支持的 Sheets、Docs 和 Node 配置，预设模式提供了更简短的精选设置。

paragraphs.en: Keep the @univerjs/* SDK packages in the same coordinated Univer release line on the same version. Independently released packages, including @univerjs/icons and @univerjs/icons-svg , use the compatible versions declared by package manifests instead of the SDK version. If you use Univer Pro packages, keep @univerjs-pro/* aligned with the matching coordinated release line.
paragraphs.zh: 将 @univerjs/* SDK 包保持在同一协调发布的 Univer 版本线上，并使用相同版本。 独立发布的包，包括 @univerjs/icons 和 @univerjs/icons-svg，使用包清单（package manifests）中声明的兼容版本，而非 SDK 版本。 如果您使用 Univer Pro 包，请将 @univerjs-pro/* 与对应的协调发布版本线保持一致。

paragraphs.en: Sheets, Docs, and Slides provide spreadsheet, document, and presentation editing on Univer's shared architecture, with a consistent plugin system, command system, and Facade API.
paragraphs.zh: Sheets、Docs 和 Slides 在 Univer 的共享架构上提供电子表格、文档和演示文稿编辑功能，并拥有统一的插件系统、命令系统和 Facade API。

paragraphs.en: This repository contains Univer's open-source core and first-party OSS plugins. Univer Pro is developed separately as a commercial extension layer for advanced product surfaces, collaboration, server features, and enterprise integrations.
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库包含 Univer 的开源核心及第一方开源插件。 Univer Pro 作为商业扩展层独立开发，面向高级产品界面、协作、服务器功能与企业级集成。
